'''Blue 5''',<ref name="CCG-TenNumb" /> also known as '''Blue Squadron 5''', was an [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fighter was part of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="CCG-Blue5" /> and was flown by [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]].<ref name="CCG-TenNumb" />

During the Battle of Endor, Blue 5, piloted by Numb, led an assault against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]],<ref name="CCG-TenNumb" /> including the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]]''. Blue 5's attacks drew enemy starfighters away from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Calrissian's]] strike force.<ref name="CCG-Blue5" />
